line = input()
tokens = line.split()
n = int(tokens[0])
s = tokens[1]

inside = False
maxWord = 0
insideCount = 0
currentSize = 0

for c in s:
    if c not in ['(', ')', '_']:
        currentSize += 1
    if c == '(':
        maxWord = max(maxWord, currentSize)
        currentSize = 0
        inside = True
    elif c == ')':
        inside = False
        if currentSize > 0:
            insideCount += 1
            currentSize = 0
    elif c == '_':
        if inside and currentSize > 0:
            insideCount += 1
        elif not inside:
            maxWord = max(maxWord, currentSize)
        currentSize = 0

maxWord = max(maxWord, currentSize)
print(f"{maxWord} {insideCount}")
